conclusion_reason: The answer correctly makes s.4(1) decisive and states the s.83/s.82 fines accurately, but it never applies s.4(1) to the facts: the exemption turns on the collector's purpose (personal benefit or household activity only), which a home security camera ordinarily meets, yet the headline says it may be illegal and fined in the millions and treats the camera's view of a public road as possibly defeating the exemption, a limit the statute does not contain.

problems.quote: ล่วงล้ำไปเก็บข้อมูลของบุคคลอื่นในที่สาธารณะเกินกว่ากิจกรรมส่วนตัวหรือครอบครัว ย่อมมีปัญหาในการอ้างข้อยกเว้นนี้
problems.why: Section 4(1) exempts collection, use or disclosure by a person who collects for personal benefit or household activity only; the test is the purpose, and the text says nothing about where the data is captured or whether other people in a public place appear.
